span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the time a user began following is ESTIMATED, from the reverse-chronological order the API returns followers in, lower-bounded by each follower's account creation date
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the paper's REASON for the Bayesian treatment - that a single act from one side is a weak signal - is the sentence immediately before this one, and widening to reach it pulls in a footnote the extraction has interleaved into the body ('4Since the Twitter API restricts us to the last 3200 tweets'), so the tag is trimmed instead
span.term: each user's leaning is a beta-binomial coin-bias estimate - a uniform prior over the two sides, then one increment per follow or retweet
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: polarization is defined as DISTANCE FROM BALANCE rather than as leaning, so a strongly left and a strongly right user score identically
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: a hashtag inherits its leaning from the users who used it that week, and users who did not retweet a seed account that week contribute nothing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: two explicit noise controls chosen because the early years are thin: a minimum of five users per hashtag, and a five-week moving average
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: automated and bad-faith accounts are handled BY THE PASSAGE OF TIME rather than by detection - the study relies on Twitter having suspended them in the years before collection
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Twitter API 'most recent activity only' limitations hinder longitudinal study
span.note: what this limits: any longitudinal claim: API LIMITATIONS HINDER SUCH STUDIES - only most-recent activity is retrievable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Automated tweets and astroturfing were not detected or removed.
span.note: what this limits: the authenticity of the measured activity: WE DID NOT EXPLICITLY ATTEMPT TO DETECT ASTROTURFING AND OTHER TYPES OF AUTOMATED TWEETS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hashtag hijacking could still contaminate the content measure.
span.note: what this limits: the content measure, with the boundary decision stated: HASHTAG HIJACKING COULD STILL AFFECT OUR ANALYSIS, THOUGH THESE EFFECTS ARE ARGUABLY ALSO PART OF THE POLITICAL LANDSCAPE AND SHOULD BE INCLUDED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The study cannot settle whether social media causes, reflects or reduces offline polarization.
span.note: what this limits: any causal reading: the study cannot settle whether social media causes, reflects or reduces offline polarization
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The election-period pattern in hashtag polarization does not hold for the 2010 midterms, probably because of noisier early estimates.
span.note: what this limits: the election-period pattern: FOR THE 2010 MIDTERM ELECTIONS, HOWEVER, THIS OBSERVATION DOES NOT HOLD, POTENTIALLY DUE TO NOISIER ESTIMATES BASED ON FEWER ACTIVE USERS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Pre-September-2009 tweets were excluded because their volume was too low.
span.note: what this limits: the temporal coverage of the analysis: WE ONLY CONSIDER TWEETS FROM SEPTEMBER 2009 ONWARDS ... SINCE THE VOLUME FOR EARLIER TWEETS IS LOW
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The follow times underlying the whole time series are estimated rather than observed, and the accuracy attributed to that estimator is reported second-hand and only for accounts with millions of followers.
span.note: what this limits: the year-by-year following curve: follow dates are estimated by the method of Meeder et al., whose accuracy is reported to hold for users with millions of followers, while the analysis uses all cases with estimated follow dates from January 2009 onwards
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The content measure is not specified in this paper; its method is applied from another work and the reader is sent there for the details.
span.note: what this limits: the hashtag-polarization series: the procedure that produces it - leaning assignment, volume correction and smoothing - is taken from another paper, and this one refers the reader there for details
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Each user's polarization value is a posterior belief that begins from an assumed balance between the two sides, not a summary of that user's observed behaviour alone.
span.note: what this limits: a per-user polarization value: it is the mean of a beta posterior that starts from a uniform prior over left and right and is updated by each observed follow or retweet, so a user with few observed actions is scored largely by the prior
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
